_howto: Copy this object into src/data/aberrations.json inside the [ ]. Everything about the episode itself (title, art, date, cast, content warnings, player, Postmortem link) is pulled from the feed automatically using episodeCode, so you only write the in-universe bits. Delete keys you don't need. No em dashes.
name: The Creature Name (as the Unit refers to it)
_episodeCode: Exactly as it appears on the episodes page, with the space: S1 E12. One aberration per episode is the default; a two-parter uses the Part 1 code.
type: Short classification: Cryptid, Entity, Object, Location, Infection, Aquatic, Unknown, or whatever TRU would file it under
status: Case closed / Contained / At large / Unknown
teaser: One sentence, spoiler-free. This is the Google snippet and the card on the index page. The episode's own one-liner usually works.
entry: Two or three paragraphs with spoilers: what it is, what it does, where it turned up, how the team dealt with it. Written in-universe is fine (report voice), or plainly, your call. Paragraphs separated by a blank line.
handling: One line on how the case was resolved or contained.
firstSeen: Optional. If it showed up earlier than its episode (a mention, a Postmortem), say where. Delete this key otherwise.
